verdict.rationale: Ente Auth handles bulk work only at the import/export boundary. It offers bulk import from many 2FA apps and plaintext files, encrypted bulk export with automatic daily backups, and a scriptable CLI for automated backup and export of all codes, and a hands-on user reports a smooth bulk Aegis export/import. Day-to-day management (edit/delete) is documented only per item, via long-press or right-click. Missing for 10: multi-select bulk edit/delete/tag/trash of many codes at once, bulk operations through an API or CLI beyond export, and independent corroboration of bulk management workflows.
